tool_args.rationale: The data are non-oscillatory and cover nine rows with varied u_now and s_grad. The previous model failed fresh confirmation, so revise the mechanism rather than abstain; the barrier-modulated siphon has four parameters and can be numerically fit from the available rows without purchasing another batch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid open-branch observation already tests this ambiguity and the current rows span sink gradients from 0.25 to 2.2.
Nine rows already exceed the stated minimum for the relevant multi-parameter fits; the prior batch supplied additional diverse inputs.

considered_alternatives.option: Two-layer base siphon with square-root branch (node C)
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Plausible, but the confirmation refuted the preceding compact base-field/sink attenuation fit; the barrier-modulated siphon explicitly captures the pronounced nonlinear rise with u_now.
All observations have identical horizon, x_now, and mem_conv, providing no evidence to identify coupled dynamics; its extra parameters are unjustified.
There is only one horizon and the supplied horizon is not flagged as short relative to the target; the slow-horizon probe is unavailable in the menu.
